subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature, folded into the broader memory/files panel work, or deferred to a plugin contribution surface?
rationale: The current code has overlapping whole-file memory editing and emerging plugin UI tabs, but no settled contract for storage, prompt injection precedence, freshness, auditing, or security review of browser-editable persistent context.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Design First
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical pinned-facts item and require a maintainer design decision before implementation chooses storage, injection, and authorization semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md editing effort and close or merge this issue only after that item explicitly covers structured facts and injection freshness.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Surface
options.body: Require this capability to be implemented through Control UI plugin contribution slots once that API has the needed safe descriptor and state contracts.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Design First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical pinned-facts item and require a maintainer design decision before implementation chooses storage, injection, and authorization semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance is recent work around the gateway file surface and Agents UI paths that would need to host or reject this feature.
